load_adjacency_matrix_hdf5: load an adjacency matrix from an HDF5 file with ids, neighbors, offsets, weights, and objects
load_adjacency_matrix_csv: load an adjacency matrix from a CSV file with optional symmetrization and object mapping
load_edge_list: load an edge list from a CSV file returning indexed edges, objects, and weights
create_dataset: create a PyTorch Dataset from edge indices, objects, and weights with negative sampling support
eval_reconstruction: evaluate embedding reconstruction quality by ranking neighbors using a model and adjacency list
